description.value:
Trigger You're about to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Demoralize] with the visual trait while you're in an area of bright light.

You focus your mantle's reflective properties to overwhelm not just your target's will but also its senses. Attempt your [[/act demoralize dc=reflex traits=visual]]{Intimidation} check against the target's Reflex DC instead of its Will DC. If you critically succeed, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] until it's no longer @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened].
